speaker: Bo
text: Bo is a bear cub with caramel-brown fur, round ears and rosy cheeks. He finds the strawberries, wants them all at first, and then chooses to share them with his friends.

speaker: Dot
text: Dot is a little duckling with butter-yellow feathers and an orange beak. Dot is hungry and sad because she could not find breakfast, and she brings cool water from the pond for the picnic.

speaker: Lulu
text: Lulu is a gentle lamb with fluffy white wool and pink ears. She is Dot's friend, kindly says the berries look sweet, and brings her cozy pink blanket for the picnic.
Bo Shares the Berries is a cozy little story about sharing, starring Bo the bear cub, Dot the duckling and Lulu the lamb.
Sharing makes hearts grow bigger. When we share, we may have a few less berries, but we gain more friends, more fun, and more love.

speaker: Bo
text: Yummy, yummy! All of these berries are just for me!

One sunny morning, Bo the bear cub waddled into Clover Meadow. Beside the old oak tree he found a bush full of the reddest, juiciest strawberries he had ever seen. He picked and picked until his little basket was full to the top.
Bo the bear cub stands happily next to a strawberry bush with a basket full of berries, under a smiling sun.

speaker: Dot
text: Oh, my tummy is so rumbly. We looked everywhere, but we couldn't find any breakfast.

speaker: Lulu
text: Those berries look so sweet, Bo. You were lucky to find them.
Pitter-patter, waddle-waddle. Along came Dot the duckling and Lulu the lamb. Dot's tummy gave a loud little grumble.
Lulu the lamb and a sad, hungry Dot the duckling arrive while Bo holds his basket of berries. Dot's tummy grumbles.

speaker: Bo
text: If I share, I will have fewer berries... but my friends won't be hungry anymore.
Bo hugged his basket tight. He thought and thought. Then he looked at Dot's droopy little face, and he remembered how sad it feels to be hungry.
Bo hugs his basket and thinks hard, dreaming of berries and a heart, while Dot and Lulu wait nearby.

speaker: Bo
text: Here, friends! There are enough berries for all of us.

speaker: Dot
text: Thank you, Bo! I'll bring cool water from the pond.

speaker: Lulu
text: And I'll bring my cozy blanket. Let's have a picnic!
Bo set his basket down on the soft green grass and smiled his biggest smile.
Bo smiles and offers his berries. Dot brings a leaf cup of water and Lulu brings a pink picnic blanket.

speaker: Bo
text: Sharing made my berries taste even sweeter!
So the three friends had a picnic under the big oak tree. They munched and giggled and told silly stories until the sky turned pink.
At sunset, the three friends share a picnic on a pink blanket under the oak tree, with hearts floating above them.
